script.title: BOOKING A DENTAL CLEANING
script.story_hook: Booking a first dental cleaning by phone.
script.intro_zh: 替第一次看診預約洗牙與檢查。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're booking a dental cleaning.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天我們來預約洗牙。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。

First dentist trip and unsure how to book in English? This super-realistic dental scheduling chat teaches you in one listen. Follow the patient as a new visitor, confirm insurance coverage, ask for the earliest slot, and reschedule — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🦷牙科預約英文｜說新病人・確認保險・改約時段｜聽完就會約｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次看牙，卻不知道怎麼開口預約？
保險、新病人、改時間，用英文要怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進一家牙科診所，跟著病人從說明新病人、確認保險涵蓋，到詢問最早時段與請求改期，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🦷 預約與新病人：例如「book a dental cleaning」、「are you a new patient here」。
🪪 確認保險：例如「Do you take my insurance?」、「yes, you're fully covered」。
📅 詢問與改期：例如「How soon can you fit me in?」、「is Thursday after two better?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來預約牙醫可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up an insurance card at the desk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a dental cleaning.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tu bʊk ə ˈdɛntəl ˈklinkɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, are you a new patient here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli ɑr ju ə nu ˈpeɪʃənt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你是這裡的新病人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, this is my very first visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈvɛri fɜrst ˈvɪzɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. We'll add x-rays, that's standard.
dialogue.zh: 好。我們會加拍 X 光片，這是標準流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. Do you take my insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd du ju teɪk maɪ ɪnˈʃʊrəns/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。你們收我的保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which company, so I can check today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈkʌmpəni soʊ aɪ kæn tʃɛk təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哪家公司？讓我先幫你查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Blue Shield, here's my card number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts blu ʃild hɪrz maɪ kɑrd ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 是 Blue Shield，這是我的卡號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, one moment while I verify it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wʌn ˈmoʊmənt waɪl aɪ ˈvɛrəfaɪ ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, take your time, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr teɪk jɔr taɪm noʊ rʌʃ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 好，你慢慢來，完全不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, yes, you're fully covered.
dialogue.zh: 好消息，是的，你完全涵蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. How soon can you fit me in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm haʊ sun kæn ju fɪt mi ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。最快什麼時候能排到我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next Tuesday morning at nine, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈtuzˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ æt naɪn ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 下週二早上九點，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday's tough, I have a big meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪz tʌf aɪ hæv ə bɪɡ ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週二有點難，我有個重要會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, is Thursday after two better?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ɪz ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈæftər tu ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，週四兩點後會更好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday works perfectly for me, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 週四對我來說剛好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked! Just arrive ten minutes early.
dialogue.zh: 預約好了！只要早十分鐘到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Do I fill any forms online?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du du aɪ fɪl ˈɛni fɔrmz ˈɑnˌlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。我需要線上填表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll email them tonight, see you then!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ˈimɪl ðəm təˈnaɪt si ju ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 要的，我今晚 email 給你，到時見！
